name: Andy Ogles
stance: Calls AI catastrophe warnings a pretext for control and opposes slowing US AI development, while pressing for coordination with AI developers on AI-enabled cyber threats.

statements.text: There is an AI arms race. Jailbroken AI used by our adversaries poses a monumental cyber threat.
Announced a cybersecurity subcommittee hearing on how AI is transforming the cybersecurity landscape, saying AI can hack and destroy infrastructure.

OpenAI’s reported autonomous AI cyber incident should be a wake-up call. As Chairman of the Homeland Security Subcommittee on Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Protection, I'm calling for better coordination between Congress, my Subcommittee, federal agencies, and the companies developing these powerful AI systems.
Endorsed Richard Grenell's criticism of Rep. Ted Lieu for trying to slow down American AI development.
The same people who INVENTED the climate hoaxes and the COVID scam are telling us to SLOW DOWN our AI capabilities.
Dems want control over AI, and they are inventing hysteria to take it.
the AI doomsday narrative is about CONTROL. Big Tech is pushing fear to tighten its grip on American innovation and bake its liberal worldview into our AI models.
